correctness.rationale: The covariance is computed from exact random variables D=d(P)+1 and L=2ell-J(P); internal-depth U<=i(i-1)/2 and leaf-depth Q>=ell+i-1 are proved with equality iff rooted broom. Factorization (t-9)(i-3)-(i-5)^2 gives sharp sign boundary, exact finite maximization gives C_10=3/50 and cubic scaling yields 2/27. Exact enumeration confirms all rooted shapes up to order 11 and broom orders 10..100, without claiming finite tests are an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected 2013 stochastic blocks-tree model supplies the leaf-update mechanism and separate marginal depth and leaf results, but not the exact mixed covariance or the optimal block morphology and sharp 9/10 vertex sign boundary. Searches of published-finding corpus and relevant primary literature returned ordinary recursive-tree profile covariance and unrelated broom extremals, not statements whose implication covers the claimed two-block theorem. The proof is a self-contained strengthening for a different cross-statistic, with remaining priority risk that an uninspected general tree-status theorem yields the deterministic portion.
residual_risks: Only selected relevant Guo–Zhou full-text theorems were compared; general deterministic tree-status results elsewhere may encompass the extremal depth inequality, though not necessarily the stochastic claim as stated.
No exhaustive global priority search is possible; general covariance results of rooted-forest growth may imply the claim without an identical title.
The main source was publicly presented in a dated February 2013 seminar; availability of a still earlier manuscript was not established.

value.rationale: The natural first nontrivial attachment in a published stochastic tree-growth model raises the intrinsic joint question of whether selecting a deeper graft vertex creates or destroys leaves. Complete fixed-size optimization, unique shape classification, sharp positive-covariance threshold t=10, and asymptotic 2/27 envelope are structural and useful even though extension to later insertion stages is open.
